---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new skill, script, template, or methodology improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## What problem does this solve

Describe the use case or pain point. E.g., "I manage 20 e-commerce sites and need a way to..."

## What you'd like the toolkit to do

A clear description of the new capability.

## Type of contribution

- [ ] New skill (`/{name}` slash command in `.claude/skills/`)
- [ ] New script (cron-fired routine or one-shot utility in `scripts/`)
- [ ] New template (`templates/`)
- [ ] Methodology improvement (`SEO_GUIDE.md` / `on-page-seo.md` / `CLAUDE.md`)
- [ ] New platform support (e.g., adding Squarespace / Framer / Webflow specifics to `WORKFLOWS.md`)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Something else

## Alternatives you've considered

Did you try doing this manually first? With another tool? What didn't work?

## Are you willing to contribute this yourself

- [ ] Yes — I'll draft a PR (just want to discuss the approach first)
- [ ] Yes — but I'd like guidance on where to start
- [ ] No — flagging the need, hoping someone else picks it up

If yes, see `CONTRIBUTING.md` for the contribution workflow.

## Anything else

Examples, links, related work in other SEO tools, screenshots.
